title: Scam Alert: State Warns Public About Fraudulent Letters Referencing a State Agency
summary: Hawaii Green Infrastructure Authority — DBEDT and Hawaii Green Infrastructure Authority, in partnership with the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs Office of Consumer Protection, is alerting Hawaii residents to a series of fraudulent mailers that use HGIA’s name to imply legitimacy in home warranty and mortgage protection scams.
author: David Hiromoto
title_norm: scam alert state warns public about fraudulent letters referencing a state agency
